description: This file defines a React functional component 'MakeMCPPublicForm' used for rendering a multi-step modal form that allows users to select MCP servers and make them public. It manages state for selected servers, handles user interactions, and performs an API call to update server visibility status.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets form state and closes the modal.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances to the next step after validating server selection.

methods.name: handlePrevious
methods.description: Goes back to the previous step.

methods.name: handleServerSelection
methods.description: Updates the set of selected servers based on user checkbox interaction.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits the selected server IDs to the API to make them public, with loading and error handling.

methods.name: renderStep1Content
methods.description: Renders UI for selecting MCP servers, including checkboxes and server info.

methods.name: renderStep2Content
methods.description: Renders confirmation UI with the list of servers to be made public.

methods.name: renderStepContent
methods.description: Chooses which step's content to display based on currentStep.

methods.name: renderStepButtons
methods.description: Renders navigation buttons for the multi-step form.
